summary: Iter 388 - Full backend + frontend E2E testing of the new Jitsi-based Video Consultation feature (debit at JOIN, idempotent, secure room name). 5/5 backend pytest pass. Full E2E UI flow PASS: login -> /video-consult -> book vp_doc1 -> duration 15 -> Continuer -> Lobby (37,50 EUR, 15 min) -> Demarrer l'appel -> Jitsi iframe on meet.jit.si mounted with backend-generated room (sbconsult-<token>) -> Quitter -> 'Consultation terminee !' success screen. Cashback (~2%) is correctly credited back on join.
critical_code_review_comments: join_video_session: cashback try/except swallows ALL exceptions silently (except Exception: pass). If award_cashback ever throws unexpectedly it will mask real bugs. Consider logging at WARNING level.

create_video_session does NOT validate that body.total_price actually equals provider.price_per_min * duration_min. The client computes total_price and the backend trusts it - a hostile client could request a $0 consultation. Recommend computing total server-side from DEMO_VIDEO_PROVIDERS table.

end_video_session is callable by the user at any moment - even before join. Not necessarily a bug but worth confirming: an unauthenticated 'end' on a never-joined session would mark it 'completed' and block any future join, with no refund logic needed since no debit happened. OK as-is.
VideoCall.jsx: disableThirdPartyRequests=true is fine for privacy but may break some Jitsi features (analytics, etc). Acceptable trade-off.
VideoCall.jsx onReadyToClose only triggers onClose; consider also handling videoConferenceLeft event for robustness when user closes Jitsi via the in-call hangup.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (full E2E flow including real Jitsi iframe mount and graceful close)

test_credentials: famtester@demo.sb / FamTest123!  -- wallet was depleted to 16.25 EUR by backend tests; refilled to 500.00 EUR via direct Mongo update to allow E2E join. freeuser@demo.sb / FreeUser123! used for insufficient balance test.
seed_data_creation: Refilled famtester wallet to 500.00 EUR (db.wallets.update_one). Created multiple video_sessions (TEST_iter388 in notes) during testing - may want to clean up if regression suite runs repeatedly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is /app/backend/tests/test_iter388_video_consult.py - safe to re-run as long as famtester wallet has >= ~150 EUR (test consumes ~75 EUR net per full pass). The insufficient-balance test gracefully skips if freeuser happens to have enough balance. Jitsi iframe loads correctly on meet.jit.si; gum.not_found audio/video errors in headless are normal.
rca of the issue: No bug found. The first backend test run failed solely because the test tolerance did not account for cashback credit (~2% = 0.75 EUR on 37.50 EUR). The actual backend behavior is correct: debit total, then credit cashback as separate wallet transaction. Test tolerance was updated to expect net debit between 95% and 101% of total.
